title.zh: 核心区别：比较的不是“谁更高级”
title.en: Core distinction: the comparison is not “which is more advanced”

subtitle.zh: 耦合方式、功率分工与鞘层行为决定工艺窗口
subtitle.en: Coupling method, power allocation and sheath behavior determine the process window

body.zh: 线圈耦合→电子加热→电离/解离
body.en: Coil coupling → electron heating → ionization / dissociation

body.zh: CCP | 电容耦合（通常 13.56 MHz）RF
电极电场→鞘层/自偏压→离子入射
body.en: Electrode field → sheaths / self-bias → ion incidence

body.zh: 电离/解离产生离子与自由基
body.en: Ionization / dissociation Generate ions and radicals

body.zh: Bulk Plasma + Sheath体等离子体＋鞘层
body.en: Bulk Plasma + Sheath Bulk plasma + sheath

body.zh: 离子＋自由基到晶圆沉积/刻蚀/清洗
body.en: Ions + radicals reach the wafer Deposition / etching / cleaning
A. What should actually be compared

body.zh: 耦合结构线圈vs电极感应vs电容
body.en: Coupling structure Coil vs electrode Inductive vs capacitive

body.zh: Source-Bias关系功率分工耦合/解耦程度
body.en: Source–Bias relationship Power allocation Degree of coupling / decoupling

body.zh: 压力与气体可达压力范围气体化学
body.en: Pressure and gas Accessible pressure range Gas chemistry

body.zh: 频率与几何13.56 / 多频 / 脉冲电极/线圈几何
body.en: Frequency and geometry 13.56 / multifrequency / pulsed Electrode / coil geometry

body.zh: ICPICP：更易分配Source与Bias角色但并非完全解耦。
body.en: ICP ICP: Source and Bias roles are easier to allocate, But they are not completely decoupled.

body.zh: CCPCCP：结构直接，密度/鞘层/化学往往更强耦合。
body.en: CCP CCP: direct structure; density / sheath / chemistry Are often more strongly coupled.

body.zh: 相同功率=相同离子能量
选型 ≠ 选设备通道数，关键：功率怎么配＋鞘层怎么控
body.en: Selection ≠ choosing the number of equipment channels; the key is how power is allocated and sheaths are controlled

notes.zh: 原图在CCP示意中将上鞘层标作“正鞘层”、下鞘层标作“负鞘层”，并同时把上电极写作接地或浮地、图中接RF；这里忠实保留，不将该示意当成普遍电势极性的定义。
notes.en: The CCP source labels the upper sheath “positive” and lower sheath “negative,” and labels the upper electrode grounded or floating while drawing an RF connection. These source details are retained, not treated as universal definitions of sheath potential polarity.

uncertain: 原图在CCP示意中将上鞘层标作“正鞘层”、下鞘层标作“负鞘层”，并同时把上电极写作接地或浮地、图中接RF；这里忠实保留，不将该示意当成普遍电势极性的定义。
